cases.name: defining-module-instance-scope
cases.source:
module Root where
import Fixed.API
import qualified Scope.User as U
main = putStrLn U.value

extra_modules.Scope.User:
module Scope.User (value) where
import Fixed.Class (Render(..))
value : String
value = render 7

cases.rationale: The explicit unqualified String contract closes wanted evidence within Scope.User, which does not import Fixed.Instances. Root's extra instance visibility must not leak into this signed definition.
